title: Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy explicitly disables cross-origin isolation
description: The response sets Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy to unsafe-none, the value that disables cross-origin isolation. The rule reports the explicit opt-out only: credentialless is a valid isolation mode and is not reported, and a missing header is reported separately by DPK-DAST-012.
remediation: Immediate: send `Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: require-corp` on documents that need cross-origin isolation, or `credentialless` where subresources cannot carry CORP headers. Durable: set it together with `Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin`, and keep an inventory of every embedded origin so a new third-party widget is checked before it ships. Trade-off: cross-origin images, scripts and frames that do not opt in stop loading, which will break third-party embeds until they add CORP or CORS headers.
limitation: Value check: flags the explicit unsafe-none value only. A missing header is a separate finding (DPK-DAST-012); credentialless is a valid isolation mode and is not reported.
